violations.text: Establishment is lacking an allergen statement. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in both hand-washing sinks. PIC relocated items. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Working containers of (dry ingredients), located in service area and back storage area, are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The presence of pest is not controlled as evidenced by (dropping underneath mop sink). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
